fields.text: Create a five-second product-motion concept from an object and one camera move. Default: a Volt night-ride radio under hard cyan rim. GLM Flash structures the brief; Omni Flash 1.1 renders 5s at 360p / 16:9 (video step $0.195, plus text). No upload required. Inspect stable object shape and coherent motion. The generated object is a concept, not an exact real product.

One compact matte-charcoal Volt pocket night-ride radio with a sharp electric-cyan lightning-bolt chevron on the face, resting on a charcoal stone plinth. Single hard cyan rim light from camera-right, deep shadow on the left, dark studio void. No letters, branding, extra props or text.

fields.options:
camera makes a slow quarter-orbit; the radio stays still as hard cyan rim light rakes across the charcoal shell and cyan chevron
locked camera; the radio rotates slowly clockwise, cyan rim light sliding around the charcoal shell and lightning chevron
slow camera push-in; the radio stays still until the cyan chevron fills the frame
fields.selected: camera makes a slow quarter-orbit; the radio stays still as hard cyan rim light rakes across the charcoal shell and cyan chevron

fields.system: Write one text-to-video prompt from the object brief and selected move. Preserve the object, material, color, setting and number of objects. Specify one continuous five-second shot with exactly the selected object and camera motion. Keep object geometry consistent; stable exposure and realistic contact shadows. Do not introduce weather, people, text, extra objects, cuts or additional camera moves. Output prompt only, 60-100 words.
